description: This file contains unit tests for drain file management functions in the starboard loader application, including creating, checking, clearing, and ranking drain files, as well as handling expired files and directory preparation.

classes.name: DrainFileTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing drain file operations, setting up and tearing down test directories.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates a temporary directory for testing.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests, clears drain files for the app.

methods.name: GetTempDir
methods.description: Returns the path to the temporary directory used for testing.

methods.name: FileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: EnsureDirectoryExists
methods.description: Ensures that a directory exists at the specified path, creating it if necessary.
